Five descriptions of the same entity, collected from different places.

---

SOURCE 1 — GitHub README, first line

> Kettleridge is a load-testing tool for API teams that replays real production traffic
> against a staging environment.

---

SOURCE 2 — kettleridge.dev homepage hero

> Test with the traffic you actually get. Kettleridge is a load-testing tool that replays your
> real production requests against staging, so the load you rehearse is the load you serve.

---

SOURCE 3 — conference talk bio

> Priya builds Kettleridge, a load-testing tool for API teams. Previously platform
> engineering at two payments companies.

---

SOURCE 4 — docs site landing page

> Kettleridge is a load-testing tool for API teams. It captures a window of production
> requests, strips credentials and personal data, and replays the resulting trace against a
> staging environment at whatever multiple of original volume you choose. Replay preserves
> request ordering and inter-arrival timing, so bursty traffic stays bursty rather than being
> flattened into a uniform rate.

---

SOURCE 5 — package registry description

> Load-testing tool for API teams. Replays captured production traffic against staging.
> Preserves timing and ordering.
